title: Working with Celestin and Emma Barrett
summary: A few jobs with Celestin and many with Emma Barrett, including Brennan's.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: Did you ever play with Celestan or Emma Barrett?
I played a couple of jobs with Papa, but not to be in the band, you know, not regular, no. Did you ever work with Emma Barrett much? Emma? Sure, I worked with Emma a good many times.
I was thinking you'd work with her soon.

I worked with her a good many times, yeah. I think I worked with her originally. And that before carnival, I think it was during the carnival season, gone. I worked at Brennan's, up here on the... Yeah, I worked there. She was at the absent house. Yeah. She lost, I think she lost out there. Yeah, she's not there anymore now. She had that job, you see.
I just wondered in the old days, a long time ago, 30 years or so ago, if you ever played with her. She used to be with Celestan or Emma Barrett.
